Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1999.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Mi’an. Mi'an Xianjie owns the retained deployment: teaches at the grandee's service that when mind and dharmas are both forgotten it is like drumming the poison drum where all who hear perish, and again like a great mass of fire, near it and it scorches your face, so that those who wake stand as buddhas on the spot and those lost revolve for eternal kalpas, since the buddhas only speak this mind and the patriarchs only transmit this dharma.

Occurrences.Kwic: 當人直截荷負，卸却從前學解，明昧兩岐，到淨裸裸處，更須轉向那邊，見佛殺佛，見祖殺祖，向衲僧門下，猶是奴兒婢子邊事。大丈夫漢，莫向禪床角老和尚口邊，覔禪覔道，覔玄覔妙，𡎺向臭皮袋裏，為究竟法，不亦謬乎？睦州凡見僧云：見成公案，放你三十棒。俱胝見僧竪指，秘魔見僧擎杈，至於玄沙未徹，從上諸宿德，無不的的痛處提持，如大火聚，孰敢近傍？近傍則燎却面門。又如金翅擘海，直取龍吞，更無回互。有如是氣槩，具如是英特，方可稱為大丈夫事。莫祇守老鼠見解，弄三寸光，巡門傍戶，見人道好，從之於好，見人道惡，從之於惡，誠可憐憫。麻谷一日持錫至章敬，遶禪床一匝，振錫一下，卓然而立。敬云：是，是。又持錫至南泉，遶禪床一匝，振錫一下，卓然而立。泉云
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1359.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Ying’an Tanhua. Ying'an Tanhua owns the retained deployment: runs Muzhou's ready-made case, Zhizhi's one raised finger, and Bimo's trident down the whole line of old worthies from Xuansha's half-clearing, each held up at its exact aching point like a great mass of fire that none dare approach, approach it and it scorches your face, again like the golden-winged bird splitting the sea to swallow the dragon outright with nothing held back.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (B/B25/B25n0145.xml). Extensive Record of Zhongfeng Mingben of Tianmu. Zhongfeng Mingben owns the retained deployment: warns students not to take such sayings as a kind of principle and so smear their own field of clean white with wild-fox spittle, since the ancients' opening of the mouth was like a great mass of fire and a great wind-wheel with nowhere for you to touch down, and like a sharp sword drawn casually out, wanting straight out to cut the life-root, which no measuring by mind, consciousness, and conception can attain.

Xueqiao Yuanxin owns the retained deployment: opens the end of the retreat for the layman Lu Dengzhi saying the binding and loosing were all for the one great matter under each person's heels, unclear like a great mass of fire with no coolness to be had, and though not one head showed in the hall the whole term through, all is at peace, naming himself the one-legged stand on the crest of ten thousand fathoms, the white-taking thief of the human world.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X72/X72n1435.xml). Expanded Record of Chan Master Wuyi Yuanlai. Wuyi Yuanlai owns the retained deployment: tells his cousins that getting it is like a great mass of fire and not getting it is also like a great mass of fire, on the high mountain no roosting birds, in the deep water fine fish, before granting that Boyan saying it this way is also just ladling at empty sounds, and that they must all look closely, since the grand counselor Zhang's one grandmother-heart only wants them to find a place to enter.

Miyun Yuanwu owns the retained deployment: opens the furnace with prajna as a great mass of fire, propound on it and it scorches your face, then suddenly snatches up his staff and raps it again and again for the one who does not shun the fire at the furnace to come meet the staff, teaching that the flame itself preaches for the buddhas of the three times and that only the dead log gone all-body- blaze may join its light to the patriarch lamp.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J28/J28nB202.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baichi. Baichi Xingyuan owns the retained deployment: at the seat the seaside patrons request, sets the pivots of the buddhas and the handles of the patriarchs strewn plainly before him like a great mass of fire, then snatches up his staff so that calling it a staff is a miss and not calling it a staff is a turning away, a saying with no needle-point of room for anyone to reason over, needing only the well-rooted and sharp-witted who reverse the spearhead at first hearing.

Senses.Explanation: Like a great mass of fire, and the masters who forbid approach to what they hold up. Mi'an Xianjie teaches that when mind and dharmas are both forgotten it is like drumming the poison drum, all who hear it perish, and again like a great mass of fire, near it and it scorches your face, so that those who wake stand as buddhas on the spot and those lost revolve for eternal kalpas, Ying'an Tanhua runs Muzhou's ready-made case, Zhizhi's one finger, Bimo's raised trident down the whole line of the old worthies, each held up at its exact aching point like a great mass of fire that none dare approach, approach it and it scorches your face, again like the golden-winged bird splitting the sea to swallow the dragon outright, Zhongfeng Mingben warns students not to smear their own clean field with fox spittle by taking such sayings for some kind of principle, since the ancients' opening of the mouth was like a great mass of fire and a great wind-wheel with nowhere to touch down, and like a sharp sword drawn casually to cut the life-root, and Xueqiao Yuanxin opens the retreat's end saying it was all for the one great matter under each person's heels, unclear like a great mass of fire with no coolness to be had, naming himself the white-taking thief standing on one foot at the crest of ten thousand fathoms. Wuyi Yuanlai tells his cousins that getting it is like a great mass of fire and not getting it is also like a great mass of fire, on the high mountain no roosting birds, in the deep water fine fish, before granting that Boyan too is just ladling at an empty sound, Yongjue Yuanxian grades Fenyang's three phrases as like a great mass of fire, near it you may not go, turn your back and it is not fire, Miyun Yuanwu opens the furnace with prajna as a great mass of fire, propound on it and it scorches your face, then raps his staff for the one who does not shun the flame at the furnace, and Baichi Xingyuan sets the pivots of the buddhas and the handles of the patriarchs strewn before him like a great mass of fire, where calling it a staff is a miss and not calling it a staff is a turning away.
